newsitem.title: USA: IBM introduces voice recognition software.
newsitem.headline: IBM introduces voice recognition software.

text.p: International Business Machines Inc said on Wednesday it introduced a new speech recognition software which enabled people to dictate to a computer rather than type e-mail messages and letters.

The software, VoiceType Simply Speaking for Windows 95 was a consumer version of IBM's VoiceType family of products, the company said. With it, people could dictate to a computer at speeds of 70 to 100 words per minute without using their hands, IBM said. They could also correct their dictation.
Users could also save and edit a vocal file, IBM said.
It was not immediately known when the software would be available and at what price.
